name: Adachi Emi
source:
[url=/c88591]Shinohara Mizuho[/url]'s homeroom teacher.
Adachi Emi is a childhood friend of the protagonist and has known him for a long time.
Surprisingly, she has an old-fashioned personality and a strong belief regarding chastity.
When she was in college, she was a member of the tennis club.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
